dayLines: You push through the doors into open air. Haven grounds — tents, a fire pit, worn paths. The world is that way.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 1 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
You break ground behind the hall — bed 2 of 2, turned and ready. Sow seed to start a crop.
💧 A person, maybe 30s, with a missing fingertip returns with water: +2 clean.
💧 A man, maybe 20s returns with water: +4 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands returns with water: +2 clean.
🍲 A man, maybe 20s is hunched over their bowl by the fire, eating like it matters.
📨 Word came: Catalina Reyes wants to join Haven. "Heard about this place three valleys over. Had to try." — they haven't set foot here. The village will judge.
📓 Journal: Catalina Reyes applied remotely.

"Hey." A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to." (Talk to A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles.)
Recipe: Bark armor (Level 1). You have seen bark armor. Plates of bark laced together, worn like a shell.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
Village meal: +1200 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🔍 A crouches over a tall weed with star-shaped leaves and spiny pods holding beautiful mottled beans, studying it a moment before moving on. (1/3 looks)
A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles came back with 778 kcal of something edible. The pantry breathes.
Leo and Nora lingered over the fire together.
Leo and Tika lingered over the fire together.

🤒 Leo is achy and wrung out, barely eating. Rest and clean water — or it gets worse.
Arlo sits with Leo — cool cloth, bitter tea, watching the breathing.
— DAY 2 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 the woman in her 40s, with restless hands, the doctor starts a story with "back when I was a doctor..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
📓 Journal: jotted down what they said (A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands).
A woman, maybe 60s, with calloused knuckles will work the garden once each day while at Haven. Other orders take priority.
You step into the Haven hall.
📋 A person, maybe 30s, with a farmer's tan — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm watches you give the order. "Interesting. Nobody asked me."
📋 A woman, maybe 50s — 🎣 Fish. They'll report back by next part.
A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm doesn't say a word. They just stand there, arms crossed, until you finish giving the order. The silence does the talking.
(Talking costs a little energy — 10 kcal a conversation. Small talk is cheap; going deep costs time, not more food.)
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 40s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.
"Dmitri," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Dmitri." You'll remember that.
📓 Journal: learned their name (Dmitri).
...and then it lands: A man, maybe 30s speaks 🇺🇸 English. A few shared words. Gestures. Patience.

"Nora," they say, touching their chest. "I'm Nora." You'll remember that.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
The trail is worn smooth as an old coin. Deer, probably. Probably.
Something big is moving in the woods. The birds went quiet.
Movement — an armadillo rooting in the leaf litter, armor clanking.
👁 It doesn't run — the armor IS the plan. It'll hunch down and dare you. The armor turns a blow; grab the soft underbelly, or trap the grub trail at night.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 9 people, 3 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 3 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
You catch fragments by the fire — A woman, maybe 60s, with a burn-scarred forearm telling Ingrid about you. Three retellings in, nobody remembers what actually happened — but everyone has opinions.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

★ IDENTIFIED: Beechnut. Small three-sided nuts in spiny little cases under the smooth gray-barked trees. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know Beechnut too.

A person, maybe 30s, with a missing fingertip spends the afternoon with the shrub with small oval leaves and clusters of bright red berries on bare twigs — look, smell, the smallest taste, then waiting. An hour passes. Then another. Nothing. The fire nods. That's dinner, maybe.
From the lumped bag: Spicebush — named, and out.
★ IDENTIFIED: Spicebush. Small oval leaves, red berry clusters on bare twigs. Crushed leaves smell spicy. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
💡 Spicebush. The shrub with small oval leaves and clusters of bright red berries on bare twigs you've been looking at for days finally has a name, and now you'll never unsee it.
A woman, maybe 40s, with restless hands was watching. Now they know Spicebush too.
Ingrid traded something with someone for something else. The barter economy stirs.
🤢 Arlo's stomach knots — something in their meal was off.
🍽️ Consuelo sets the sharing basket down by the fire instead of the pantry. "Full shelves don't need my little more."
📓 Journal: Dmitri taught the man in his 20s Old World Caches.

🛟 Nora stands up by the fire. "People are going down and the tents are filling — we do something or we don't, but we decide. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"The sick need tending — triage tents, broth, boiled water. Or we tighten our belts and wait it out. Or the hale hunt while the sick lie still."
"Or we rally," Nora adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Journal: Nora proposed relief (sickness), day 3.
